title: Do I Need CI/CD? An Honest Answer for Solo Devs and Small Teams
linkedin:
Split the acronym.

CD, automatically deploying on every push, is worth it almost immediately, even solo, because manual deploys are where silly, expensive mistakes live. CI, automatically building and testing on every push, pays off once you have real tests and more than one person committing. So adopt push-to-deploy now, add automated testing as your code and team grow.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/do-i-need-cicd/
